author: National Geographic
description:
Honor the brave men and women of the American Armed Forces this Memorial Day with a special Air Force MEGA episode from National Geographic. 🇺🇸✈️

Watch three full episodes celebrating the courage, sacrifice, and incredible technological power of the United States Air Force. In this full-length military documentary compilation, go inside the cockpits of the Mighty Eighth’s fighter jets, meet elite pilots, and discover the secrets of Air Force One. 

Episodes Featured in this Mega Episode:

Heroes of the Sky: The Mighty Eighth Air Force - 00:00
Experience the story of the airmen known as the Mighty Eighth Air Force, who seismically shifted the Allies’ fortunes during World War II. Never-before-seen archival footage allows viewers to “ride” in the cockpits of the planes that destroyed Hitler’s menacing air force, the Luftwaffe.
